stage0075_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$オットー$$
「First an assassin, now they're sending in troops.
　What are Neo Zeon's people thinking...!」

stage0075_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Do they intend to break the treaty?」

stage0075_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$オットー$$
「After everything they've pulled,
　what nerve to show up now for a handshake...!
　Launch all units!」

stage0075_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シン$$
「Did they stop $$ギュネイ$$ and the others from launching?」

stage0075_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Until we know what Neo Zeon plans,
　there's no other choice.」

stage0075_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ah, yes...
　What is it, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

stage0075_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$リディ$$
「What's your relationship with $$オードリー$$?」

stage0075_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$リディ$$
「This is a private channel.
　No one else can hear us.」

stage0075_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then maybe I've got a shot too?」

stage0075_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$リディ$$
「I like to compete fair and square on
　things like this. That's why I launched
　with you today.」

stage0075_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$リディ$$
「Seems like you're a bit ahead right now,
　but from today, we're rivals.」

stage0075_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What made you fall for $$オードリー$$, Ensign?」

stage0075_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$リディ$$
「Those eyes that seem to see right through
　everything, yet look a little sad.」

stage0075_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$リディ$$
「The rest can wait.
　Zeon's here...!」

stage0075_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$'s here...!」

stage0075_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「A Neo Zeon exec came in person just to
　announce they're tearing up the treaty!」

stage0075_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The cause lies with the Earth Federation.
　We've learned that EFF Supreme Command
　is preparing a direct strike on the colony.」

stage0075_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something like that...!
　How could that ever be allowed!」

stage0075_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（This is bad...
　Is $$ハマーン$$ trying to rattle
　us psychologically...!）

stage0075_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...
　Even if that's true, we're an independent
　unit, outside Supreme Command's authority.」

stage0075_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You should have understood that already.
　Breaking the treaty here isn't wise,
　not even for the singularity search.」

stage0075_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「The situation's changed.
　It seems even $$シャア$$ couldn't bring himself
　to trust you all under these circumstances.」

stage0075_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you saying he's given up on us...!」

stage0075_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then can you fight the Federation forces
　to protect the colony?」

stage0075_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If it comes to that, we will.」

stage0075_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I get how you feel, but isn't that pushing it?」

stage0075_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「But we can't just overlook this.」

stage0075_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$.
　We're currently confirming the situation ourselves.」

stage0075_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Depending on the situation, we may act too,
　to stop the attack on the colony.」

stage0075_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$オットー$$
「Are you sure, Commander $$ブライト$$!?」

stage0075_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What's the point of an independent unit's
　authority, then! If we keep overlooking
　their tyranny, the Federation will collapse!」

stage0075_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems you're not rotten to the core, after all.」

stage0075_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But you'll explain yourself, $$ハマーン$$.
　Why did you try to assassinate $$アムロ$$?」

stage0075_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Even the Iron Lady can't play dumb
　about something like this.」

stage0075_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$刹那$$
「We've already confirmed the assassin
　was Neo Zeon.」

stage0075_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（So that man's behind this...
　He's done something needless.）

stage0075_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（But this is good timing.
　I'll make use of the situation.）

stage0075_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...If the assassination failed,
　then we'll settle this head-on.
　All units, scatter!」

stage0075_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept Neo Zeon!
　$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, hold your position!
　Detain the Neo Zeon liaison!」

stage0075_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$コンロイ$$!
　I'm leaving that to you!」

stage0075_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（If $$マリーダ$$'s aboard, that's convenient.
　This way, we'll secure Lady $$ミネバ$$.）

stage0075_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Forgive me, Lady $$ミネバ$$.
　I won't let him use you.）

stage0075_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シン$$
「So it comes to this, after all...!」

stage0075_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...!
　What are you thinking...!）

stage0075_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept Neo Zeon!
　$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, hold your position!
　Detain the Neo Zeon liaison!」

stage0075_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$!
　I'm leaving that to you!」

stage0075_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（If $$マリーダ$$'s aboard, that's convenient.
　This way, we'll secure Lady $$ミネバ$$.）

stage0075_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Forgive me, Lady $$ミネバ$$.
　I won't let him use you.）

stage0075_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シン$$
「So it comes to this, after all...!」

stage0075_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...!
　What are you thinking...!）

stage0075_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（If you fail,
　I'll have to resort to messier means.）

stage0075_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Tch!
　As expected, gravity puts us at a disadvantage!」

stage0075_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's far enough, $$ハマーン$$!」

stage0075_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If we keep fighting like this,
　we'll only wear down our forces.」

stage0075_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$!
　Report on $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s status!」

stage0075_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$ took $$ミコット$$ hostage
　and boarded their mobile suits!」

stage0075_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「It seems $$マリーダ$$'s taken a hostage too!」

stage0075_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Just who did they take hostage!?」

stage0075_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（I can't spend any more time on this.
　$$シャア$$... I'll resort to underhanded means.）

stage0075_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$c, listen well.
　Cease your resistance at once, and
　release the Neo Zeon liaison.」

stage0075_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カツ$$
「You're the ones who broke the ceasefire,
　and you say that to us!」

stage0075_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Is that wise?
　If this demand isn't met,
　you'll turn every Zeon citizen against you.」

stage0075_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「Earth and the colonies are at war...!
　What now!?」

stage0075_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll announce that you abducted
　$$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$ and held her hostage.」

stage0075_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$!?」

stage0075_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$リディ$$
「Dozle Zabi's daughter...
　The last of the Zabi bloodline...」

stage0075_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ファ$$
「She's the hostage...? What's going on...!?」

stage0075_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I hear she's been going by $$オードリー・バーン$$.」

stage0075_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$バナージ$$
（So this is what $$フル・フロンタル$$ meant...
　someone close by that I never understood...）

stage0075_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$オットー$$
「I-If that's true,
　there's even more reason not to hand her over...!」

stage0075_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Is that wise, Captain?
　If it comes out you used the Spacenoids'
　hope as a hostage, $c will be hated.」

stage0075_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That anger and hatred will be stoked
　by the Earth supremacists' attack on the
　colony, leading to the worst outcome.」

stage0075_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Coming from someone propping up the Zabi family now!」

stage0075_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「For now, I'll accept those words.」

stage0075_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Decide, $c.
　Do you intend to stoke hatred between
　Earth and the colonies?」

stage0075_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「There's no choice...
　Release $$ギュネイ$$ and the others.」

stage0075_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミコット$$
「You lied to us... to $$バナージ$$, this whole time!」

stage0075_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Then what were you doing with $c!?」

stage0075_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「I believed there were things only I could
　do, in my position. And now, I think that
　time has come.」

stage0075_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミコット$$
「There's no way I could believe words like that!」

stage0075_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Don't think I've forgiven you.
　And if you don't take responsibility...」

stage0075_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Those words... I will never forget them.」

stage0075_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$...
　Did you know... about her?」

stage0075_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The ones trying to prop up $$ミネバ$$ Zabi
　are the old guard within Neo Zeon.
　At least, the Colonel has no such intent.」

stage0075_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Besides, they kept her existence
　a closely guarded secret, fearing assassination.
　Even I only just saw her for the first time.」

stage0075_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$リディ$$
「What are you planning to do, $$バナージ$$!?」

stage0075_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ$$!?
　Do you even know what you're doing!?」

stage0075_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You must know it too, $$マリーダ$$!
　That $$オードリー$$ doesn't want to go back!」

stage0075_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$!
　If you go back to Neo Zeon like this,
　that man will only use you!」

stage0075_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If you say you're going back of your own will,
　I won't try to stop you!
　But you...!」

stage0075_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「I am $$ミネバ$$ Zabi.
　$c, if you wish to be rid of future troubles,
　you may kill me here.」

stage0075_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「If you claim to be saving the world, then show me that pride.」

stage0075_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$!
　You can't talk like that!
　You're only cornering others, and yourself!」

stage0075_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's enough, $$バナージ$$!
　Lady $$ミネバ$$ is Neo Zeon's hope!」

stage0075_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Besides, you must have heard it too!
　What the Federation Forces are planning!」

stage0075_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Are you hurt, $$オードリー$$?」

stage0075_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$リディ$$
「This is $$リディ・マーセナス$$.
　I've secured $$ミネバ$$ Zabi.」

stage0075_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$リディ$$
「Also, from here on, I'm leaving the battlefield.」

stage0075_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$リディ$$
「You want to stop the war, don't you?」

stage0075_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「For that, I'm even prepared to give up my life.」

stage0075_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$リディ$$
「That resolve... I've taken it to heart.」

stage0075_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$リディ$$
「For the first time, I'm grateful
　to be a Marcenas.」

stage0075_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you planning to do, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

stage0075_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$リディ$$
「This isn't the time to explain in detail.
　But I intend to find the best way, with her.」

stage0075_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$... no, $$オードリー$$,
　I'll see that she's delivered where she belongs.」

stage0075_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$, tell me just one thing.
　Is that what you want to do?」

stage0075_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, I'm trusting you as a man.
　Take care of $$オードリー$$!」

stage0075_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$リディ$$
「This is between men.
　...I will protect you, no matter what.」

stage0075_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Leave it, $$マリーダ$$...!
　A clumsy pursuit would put Lady $$ミネバ$$ in danger!」

stage0075_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't say unnecessary things, $$カミーユ$$.
　You're a bit too impertinent.」

stage0075_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Reinforcements have arrived.
　I'll leave the rest to you, $$ギュネイ$$.」

stage0075_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Lady $$ミネバ$$... I leave the rest to your judgment.）

stage0075_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$...
　That woman... $$オードリー$$...」

stage0075_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「The agreement has been broken.
　From now, you and I are enemies.」

stage0075_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's how it is, $$カミーユ$$!
　Now I can settle things with you!」

stage0075_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept Neo Zeon!
　$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, move forward too!」

stage0075_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Ensign $$リディ$$...!
　Take care of $$オードリー$$!）

stage0075_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$刹那$$
「Her mind is reaching its limit...!」

stage0075_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The backlash from her enhancement is hitting her!」

stage0075_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No way...!
　That can't be...!!」

stage0075_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$, don't you recognize me!?
　$$マリーダ$$!!」

stage0075_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$バナージ$$
「To make a person become like this...
　Is this... what war is...?」

stage0075_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something like this... can't be forgiven!!」

stage0075_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Don't think ill of me, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0075_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　We've captured the Unicorn!」

stage0075_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Alright...!
　$$ガランシェール$$, withdraw!!」

stage0075_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Right now, we're under $$フル・フロンタル$$'s command.
　First, we complete the mission.」

stage0075_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Th-the Unicorn...!
　Someone! Do something, fast!!」

stage0075_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$n
「No good!
　We can't catch up from here!」

stage0075_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The withdrawal order's been given.
　We're falling back too, $$クェス$$.」

stage0075_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If we leave it to $c,
　nothing bad will happen.」

stage0075_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（$$マリーダ$$...
　Live, and let's meet again.）

stage0075_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The withdrawal order's been given.
　There's nothing to do but pull back here...」

stage0075_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（$c...
　I'm counting on you, look after $$マリーダ$$）

stage0075_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$クェス$$
「The order to retreat's out...
　I have to fall back...!」

stage0075_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$クェス$$
（I'm counting on you, $c...
　I'll leave $$マリーダ$$ to you）

stage0075_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$レイアム$$
「We've lost track of the Neo Zeon unit」

stage0075_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The truce was broken without warning,
　the girl we picked up is $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, and
　the Unicorn's been stolen... What is going on!?」

stage0075_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$オットー$$
「That's what I'd like to know...!」

stage0075_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is Neo Zeon still after
　Laplace's Box...」

stage0075_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$宗介$$
「At this stage, what is the point of that...」

stage0075_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Beats me.
　Guess we'll have to ask that $$フル・フロンタル$$
　guy for the answer」

stage0075_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've completely lost track of them too」

stage0075_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「They blasted off in the $$デルタプラス$$.
　Can't blame them」

stage0075_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Is that true, Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

stage0075_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$エマ$$
「I'm sure the Ensign's gone to their father's」

stage0075_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ノイン$$
「$$ローナン・マーセナス$$...
　A powerful figure in the Earth Federation Assembly」

stage0075_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So Ensign $$リディ$$ and $$ミネバ$$ Zabi mean to
　reach out to the Federation government's
　core on their own...」

stage0075_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「How will that move things along...」

stage0075_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch!
　Did my own needless mercy bring this on!?」

stage0075_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fall back, $$ギュネイ$$!
　I'll handle the rest!」

stage0075_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$!
　It's yours!」

stage0075_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm the one who'll repay $$ギュネイ$$'s debt!」

stage0075_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Don't push yourself, $$クェス$$.
　Don't make $$ギュネイ$$ grieve」

stage0075_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$クェス$$
「Thanks, $$マリーダ$$.
　But you're the same way too」

stage0075_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$クェス$$
「If you push yourself, $$マリーダ$$,
　it'll make me sad too」

stage0075_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$クェス$$
「...No...!
　I can't fight feeling like this!」

stage0075_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fall back, $$クェス$$.
　You've grown too attached to $c」

stage0075_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Don't push yourself.
　Leave the rest to me」

stage0075_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$.
　For making you look after $$クェス$$」

stage0075_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Since I'm the same sex as her, she'll
　listen to me honestly, at least somewhat」

stage0075_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But don't push yourself too hard, $$マリーダ$$.
　You're...」

stage0075_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I know my own body better than anyone.
　No need to worry」

stage0075_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Come back, $$クェス$$!
　You were doing fine with $c!」

stage0075_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$シャア$$ broke his promise unilaterally
　and tried to kill $$アムロ$$!
　How can you trust a man like that!?」

stage0075_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's why I'm going back to $$アクシズ$$,
　to find out what the Colonel's thinking!」

stage0075_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No, $$クェス$$!
　I won't let you go!」

stage0075_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$クェス$$
「Please understand, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　I have to see the Colonel!」

stage0075_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$!
　Is this battle $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s true intent!?」

stage0075_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's right!
　He too must have understood the Earth
　Federation's hopeless incompetence!」

stage0075_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「People who only deny each other like that
　just keep spreading the fighting further!
　Why can't you or $$シャア$$ see that!?」

stage0075_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「To think it would end like this...!
　Seems I thought too highly of
　both you and $$シャア$$!」

stage0075_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$ overrates you all too...!
　You most of all!」

stage0075_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But he's not a man to use assassination!
　Who's really behind this!?」

stage0075_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't get familiar with me, $$アムロ・レイ$$!
　If you want the truth, ask $$シャア$$ yourself!」

stage0075_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I'll beat you and do just that!」

stage0075_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「So you're $$バナージ・リンクス$$...」

stage0075_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this feeling...
　It's subtly different from hostility...!」

stage0075_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（I'll give you my thanks for protecting her, up until today）

stage0075_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（But battle is a different matter...!
　To stop his pointless scheme,
　I'll destroy that machine!）

stage0075_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$シン$$
「Why widen this fight!
　Do you even get what's at stake right now!?」

stage0075_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's exactly why we strike the Federation!
　Do that, and the obstacle to the
　singularity search disappears too!」

stage0075_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$シン$$
「You're going about this all wrong!
　Do you want a war that badly!?」

stage0075_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$キラ$$
「Please, stop this fight!
　You and $$シャア・アズナブル$$ should be able
　to find a better way!」

stage0075_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「At that rate, Earth won't last!
　What we need are results!」

stage0075_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$キラ$$
「If doing that makes someone grieve...!」

stage0075_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$キラ$$
「I'll stop you!
　That's the fight we're fighting!!」

stage0075_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$刹那$$
「Why won't you try to understand each other?
　You should be able to do it!」

stage0075_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Another rude man forcing his way into people's hearts!」

stage0075_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll teach you too!
　That entering another's heart takes
　qualifications to match!」

stage0075_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this is $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s choice!」

stage0075_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even a man like you couldn't see it coming」

stage0075_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course, I'd considered it.
　But I didn't want to believe it」

stage0075_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If that man meant to carry the whole world
　alone, we were going to lighten
　that burden for him!」

stage0075_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's my role!
　I'll eliminate you here, for leading $$シャア$$ astray!」

stage0075_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Guess it really was our fate to end up like this!」

stage0075_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$!
　Fighting us should have shown you
　just what state this world's in!」

stage0075_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're right about that!
　That's why I'll strike you down,
　not as myself, but as a Neo Zeon soldier!」

stage0075_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If the Colonel says he'll save the world,
　then I'll lend him my strength!」

stage0075_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's how it is, I'll be your opponent!
　Here I come, $$ギュネイ$$!」

stage0075_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$シン$$
「And here I thought we might actually
　get along, you and I...!」

stage0075_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Yeah, I thought so too, $$シン$$」

stage0075_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But I'm a Neo Zeon soldier!
　If the Colonel says he'll save the world,
　I'll fight with everything I've got!」

stage0075_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$シン$$
「You stubborn fool!
　Don't you get that choosing war as
　your answer is exactly the problem!?」

stage0075_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've got no interest in Laplace's Box!
　I won't hold back, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0075_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Do we really have to fight, $$ギュネイ$$!?」

stage0075_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Seems that's just our fate!
　Don't take it personally!」

stage0075_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$クェス$$
「Listen, $$アムロ$$!
　It wasn't the Colonel who tried to
　assassinate you! It has to be him!」

stage0075_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But if $$シャア$$ starts this fight again,
　I'll be the one to stop him!」

stage0075_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If he wants to settle this, I'll meet him head-on!」

stage0075_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$クェス$$
「Hasa!
　If you say you've gotten stronger, show me!
　You won't lose to the Colonel, right!?」

stage0075_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Right now, I still might not beat $$シャア$$...!」

stage0075_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「But someday, I'll surpass the Red Comet,
　I swear it! And I'll win you back!」

stage0075_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$クェス$$
「Here I come, Hasa!
　If you can't even beat me,
　beating the Colonel's just a pipe dream!」

stage0075_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Say nothing, $$バナージ$$.
　Our paths won't cross again」

stage0075_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If you can't accept it, then let yourself
　be struck down! That's what war is!」

stage0075_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$バナージ$$
「There's nothing... left but to fight!」

stage0075_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop this, $$マリーダ$$!
　Your body...」

stage0075_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm your enemy!
　Can you afford needless mercy for an enemy!?」

stage0075_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（You're kind, $$カミーユ$$...
　If he's guided by you, $$バナージ$$
　will surely grow into a strong, kind man...）

stage0075_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「This unit's pilot...!
　Seems you've gotten better!」

stage0075_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$n
「I'm desperate too!
　Dealing with a stubborn fool like you
　takes everything I've got!」

stage0075_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Quite the mouth on you, boy!
　Facing you, I might enjoy being just
　a pilot again!」

stage0075_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$n
「I'll turn that smirk into terror, $$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

stage0075_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Enjoying leading me astray like that!?
　Know your shame, you beast!」
